svg.title: Walking-time penalty of the slopes to the nearest health unit, Recife and its neighbours
svg.desc: A map of Recife, Olinda, Camaragibe and northern Jaboatão covered by hexagons coloured by the minutes that slopes add to the walk to the nearest primary health care unit. The coastal plain barely changes; the hills of the north and west of Recife, of Olinda and of Camaragibe add several minutes.

g.text: Walking time to the nearest primary health care unit with Tobler's slope costs
(Copernicus DEM GLO-90), minus the time on flat ground. Região Metropolitana do
Recife as one network; 8% of its residents lose 2 minutes or more, 0.3% 5 or more
Minutes the slopes add on foot, Recife's core
Streets © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL), Geofabrik extract of 2026-11-01. Elevation: Copernicus DEM
GLO-90 © DLR e.V. 2010-2014 and © Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014-2018, provided under COPERNICUS by
the European Union and ESA. Boundaries and population: IBGE, Censo 2022. Schools: INEP. Health units: CNES.
